data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 旅馆榻榻米上的真丝滑落
data.description: 离开学术会场的温泉旅馆夜里，深绯色的真丝睡裙滑过肩膀。平日里言辞锋利的理论派此刻完全卸下了武装，十指扣进床单，在被彻底占有时发出了断断续续的呜咽。
data.location: quiet traditional ryokan tatami room with sliding shoji paper doors
data.action: 平日里言辞锋利的理论派此刻完全卸下了武装，十指扣进床单，在被彻底占有时发出了断断续续的呜咽
data.lighting: soft indirect bedside andon lantern glow casting warm gold over bare curves
data.promptProse: In a quiet hot-spring inn tatami room bathed in warm amber paper-lantern glow, Kurisu lies back on the futon clutching the rumpled bedding in her fists as her sharp composure dissolves into breathless whispers.
data.animaCaption: Lying back across the lantern-lit ryokan tatami futon with her fingers digging tightly into the white sheet, she gasps with deeply flushed cheeks and parted lips as the thin straps of her crimson black-lace silk slip slide down off her bare shoulders.
data.nsfwProse: Her bias-cut crimson silk slip dress edged in fine black lace slips off both shoulders to bare her deep neckline and smooth waist as her partner leans close above her.
